title: Hybrid policy retrieval with rerank, measured
area: RAG at scale: hybrid search, reranking, retrieval evals
scenario: Kestrel's criteria agent uses dense search only: queries naming a policy id, HCPCS code or drug land on the wrong policy, and some answers cite retired policy versions. Build BM25 + dense with reciprocal rank fusion, LOB and effective-date filters before ranking, a bounded rerank, and the recall@k / MRR eval that proves each step.
task: Implement Okapi BM25 and reciprocal rank fusion (k=60)
Filter by line of business and effective dates before ranking
Rerank only the top N candidates
Write recall@k, MRR and a sliced eval; report the four-setup table
acceptance: Formulas match; filters exact at date boundaries
Zero retired or wrong-LOB sections in any mode
Hybrid recall@5 >= 0.95 above both single methods; rerank MRR >= 0.95
